repo.buildathonCopy: Branched from NeoRishi/lunar-sprints main at commit e69e8dc for the Google Startup Buildathon

stack.styling: Plain CSS with Moonlit tokens in src/app/globals.css plus CSS modules (no Tailwind)
stack.build: next.config.ts output standalone, for a Cloud Run container
stack.auth: Firebase Authentication (firebase in the browser, firebase-admin on the server); five-day httpOnly __session cookie from /api/auth/session
stack.database: PostgreSQL via pg (src/lib/db.ts, withUser sets app.user_id); migrations in db/migrations

firebase.credentials: Application Default Credentials only; never a downloaded service-account key

database.target: Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL in Step 2B

roles.ls_owner: owns the schema and runs migrations
roles.ls_app: used by the app; not owner, no superuser, no BYPASSRLS

database.rule: Additive migrations only. RLS enabled and forced on every ls_ table.

infrastructure.email: Firebase Authentication sends confirmation, sign-in link and password reset emails
infrastructure.hosting: Cloud Run in Step 2B. No Google Cloud billing or paid resources yet.

current.status: Step 3 Run 1: intent_alignment, smart_goal, story_decomposer and scheduling run on Gemini through the local ADK agent service. daily_execution, adaptive_backlog and reflection still return ai_not_connected (503) until Run 2.
current.engine: src/features/lunarsprints/agents/gemini-agents.ts (GeminiAgentsIntelligence, selectIntelligence): used when AGENTS_SERVICE_URL is set
current.contract: src/features/lunarsprints/agents/contract.ts, written to contracts/schemas/*.json by npm run contracts:build

agentService.stack: Python 3.12+, uv, Google ADK, FastAPI, Pydantic

current.models: From env only: GEMINI_MODEL_<ROLE>, then GEMINI_MODEL_DEFAULT
current.originalInstructions: Git-ignored .private/agent-instructions/ on the owner's Mac. Never commit.
current.voice: Off until Gemini Live API. Recording header check kept in src/lib/audio.ts

target.agentService: Separate Python ADK service on Cloud Run using Gemini

productDecisions.recommendedPreset: Paksha sprint: Pratipada to Purnima or Amavasya
productDecisions.payments: On hold. LunarSprints+ Rs 299/month shown as coming soon.
productDecisions.login: Open signup with email and password or an email sign-in link. Google sign-in later. LifeOS shared login is not part of the buildathon build.
productDecisions.reminders: Email only today; Firebase Cloud Messaging is the target
productDecisions.visualDirection: Moonlit: dark night ground, moonlight text, one soft gold accent, thin serif headlines, minimal
productDecisions.plusTier: Coming soon: up to 3 active sprints of up to 45 days (config/plans.json)

invariants: Deterministic core works with no LLM call
Never silently rebuild today's plan; plan revisions are immutable
Reality before lunar context; no fake lunar data in production
Preserve RLS: enabled and forced on every ls_ table; app connects as ls_app through withUser; no owner or admin shortcuts in user paths
No secrets in code, chat, logs or commits
No silent fallbacks: if AI is unavailable, show an honest message and keep the saved plan safe
workingRules: No reset, force push, branch deletion, history rewrite or squash
lint, typecheck, vitest and build must pass before every PR
Ask before live DB changes, DNS, cloud project settings or deleting files
Stop at the requested phase and report
communication: Clarifying multiple-choice questions with a recommended answer before big work
Flag fake testimonials or unverifiable claims

externalRepos.goal: Remove AI-slop from the product: UI, copy and code quality

migration.plan: 7 steps for the Google Startup Buildathon
migration.step1: Done: clean slate, previous AI vendors, hosting config and voice transcription removed
migration.step2a: Done: Firebase Authentication and local PostgreSQL with forced RLS, at no cost
migration.step2b: Not started: Cloud SQL, Cloud Run, Secret Manager, real sign-in emails
migration.step3run1: Done on branch feat/step3a-adk-planning-agents: ADK agent service with intent_alignment, smart_goal, story_decomposer and scheduling on Gemini

tests.rls: npm run test:rls (needs DATABASE_URL_TEST; fails, never skips)
tests.auth: npm run test:auth (runs on the Auth emulator)
